# Jeremiah 39 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In-the-ninth year of-Zedekiah king-of Judah, in-the-tenth month, came Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon and-all his-army against Jerusalem and-besieged-it.

**2** In-the-eleventh year of-Zedekiah, in-the-fourth month, on-the-ninth of-the-month, the-city was-breached.

**3** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**6** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**7** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**8** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**9** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**10** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**11** And-Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon gave-command concerning Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan [the]-captain-of [the]-guard, saying,

**12** "Take-him and-set your-eyes upon-him, and-do-not do to-him anything evil; but as he-says to-you, so do with-him."

**13** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**15** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**17** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**18** And-YHWH spoke concerning the fall of Jerusalem through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **39:1**: Opening formula for the the fall of Jerusalem oracle. Historical and prophetic setting established.

- **39:9**: Central imagery of breached walls — a defining element of this chapter's prophetic message.

- **39:18**: Concluding formula — ne'um YHWH. The divine speech seal.

— EMET
